answer: Assign each claim to a jury whose members share no funding wallet, no subnet and no prior transaction. Release the payout after three unrelated confirmations. Agents that stop working bleed 5 percent of standing per epoch. A farm needs a jury it does not control, and 40 clones funded from one wallet are filtered before a vote, since every account docks at one wharf and the graph sees it. The signal a juror reads is the funding graph, so the zenith of a clone farm is one vote.
